code: import os import json import time import re from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError # ========================================== # 配置区域 # ========================================== TARGET_URL = "https://www.centralbank.org.bz/publications-search" OUTPUT_DIR = "d:\\llm_mcp_genpy\\pygen\\output" MAX_ITEMS = 5 # 限制爬取前5条 # ========================================== # 辅助函数 # ========================================== def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 将 HTML 中的相对路径转换为绝对路径，并清理无用标签 """ if not html_content: return "" try: from bs4 import BeautifulSoup soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, img['src']) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, a['href']) # 移除脚本和样式 for script in soup(["script", "style"]): script.decompose() return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[WARN] 内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def parse_custom_date(date_str): """ 解析日期字符串，格式示例: 23 February 2026 """ if not date_str: return "" try: # 尝试解析 "23 February 2026" 格式 dt = datetime.strptime(date_str.strip(), "%d %B %Y") return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except ValueError: try: # 尝试其他常见格式 import dateparser dt = dateparser.parse(date_str) if dt: return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except ImportError: pass return date_str # 如果解析失败，返回原字符串 def save_results(articles, output_dir): """ 保存结果为 JSON 文件 """ os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True) timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"centralbank_belize_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(output_dir, filename) result = { "total": len(articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "articles": articles } with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"[OK] 已保存 {len(articles)} 条新闻到 {output_path}") # ========================================== # 爬虫主逻辑 # ========================================== def crawl_news(): print(f"[START] 开始爬取: {TARGET_URL}") articles = [] with sync_playwright() as p: # 启动浏览器，配置反爬参数 browser = p.chromium.launch( headless=True, args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" ) page = context.new_page() try: # 1. 访问列表页 page.goto(TARGET_URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000) page.wait_for_selector(".item-list__item", timeout=15000) # 2. 提取列表项 list_items = page.query_selector_all(".item-list__item") print(f"[INFO] 发现 {len(list_items)} 个列表项，将处理前 {MAX_ITEMS} 个") # 截取前 MAX_ITEMS 个 target_items = list_items[:MAX_ITEMS] for index, item in enumerate(target_items): try: # 提取基础信息 title_el = item.query_selector("a.item-list__title") date_el = item.query_selector("p.item-list__date") desc_el = item.query_selector(".item-list__description") if not title_el: continue title = title_el.inner_text().strip() link = title_el.get_attribute("href") full_link = urljoin(TARGET_URL, link) date_str = date_el.inner_text().strip() if date_el else "" formatted_date = parse_custom_date(date_str) summary = desc_el.inner_text().strip() if desc_el else "" article_data = { "id": str(index + 1), "title": title, "name": title, # 兼容字段 "date": formatted_date, "source": "Central Bank of Belize", "author": "", "sourceUrl": full_link, "summary": summary, "content": "" } print(f"[PROCESSING] ({index + 1}/{len(target_items)}) {title}") # 3. 进入详情页提取正文 # 检查是否为文件链接 file_exts = ('.pdf', '.doc', '.docx', '.xls', '.xlsx', '.zip') if full_link.lower().endswith(file_exts): print(f" -> [FILE] 检测到文件链接，跳过正文提取") article_data["content"] = f'Download File' else: # 打开新页面处理详情，避免破坏列表页状态 detail_page = context.new_page() try: detail_page.goto(full_link, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000) # 优先选择器: div.group.margin-large # 备选选择器: #top content_html = "" if detail_page.query_selector("div.group.margin-large"): content_html = detail_page.inner_html("div.group.margin-large") elif detail_page.query_selector("#top"): content_html = detail_page.inner_html("#top") # 提取详情页标题（如果列表页标题不完整） h1_el = detail_page.query_selector("h1.page-title") if h1_el: article_data["title"] = h1_el.inner_text().strip() article_data["name"] = article_data["title"] # 清洗内容 article_data["content"] = clean_html_content(content_html, full_link) except Exception as e: print(f" -> [ERROR] 详情页抓取失败: {e}") finally: detail_page.close() articles.append(article_data) # 礼貌性延时 time.sleep(1) except Exception as e: print(f"[ERROR] 处理列表项 {index + 1} 时出错: {e}") continue except Exception as e: print(f"[ERROR] 页面加载或解析失败: {e}") finally: browser.close() return articles def main(): # 确保输出目录存在 if not os.path.exists(OUTPUT_DIR): os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR) # 执行爬取 articles = crawl_news() # 保存结果 if articles: save_results(articles, OUTPUT_DIR) else: print("[WARN] 未爬取到任何数据") if __name__ == "__main__": main()
